subject: HelixCare demo hold — priority realignment and calendar pause
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixcare.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <michael.turner@helixcare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed 45min demo — HelixCare inference pilot

Hi Aditi —

Following our discovery last week, attaching a short 45-minute agenda and a two-slide summary of how Redwood handles latency-sensitive inference for healthcare workloads. Proposed demo windows next week:

- Wed 07/28 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 07/29 14:00–14:45 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple of windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Goal for the session: quick walkthrough of a sample inference flow, expected perf on 2k token sequences, and options for private deployment (VPC).

Attachments: HelixCare-demo-agenda.pdf, HelixCare-sprint-map.png

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0148

From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixcare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <michael.turner@helixcare.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed 45min demo — HelixCare inference pilot

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick turnaround and the agenda. I shared with the product and infra leads this morning. Two quick updates from our end:

1) We’re in the middle of quarterly planning and the product team just reprioritized the roadmap. The LLM/inference pilot is being pushed off to the backlog while we focus on core data-pipeline work and a compliance-related initiative.
2) Michael and I are traveling the week of 7/26 for on-site vendor reviews, so calendar alignment is rough until mid-August.

Given both of those, can we park the demo for now? I don’t want to block your calendar while we sort internal priorities. We’ll revisit once the roadmap cadence stabilizes — likely when we finalize Q4 planning (tentatively early Q1 FY28). When that happens I’ll reach back out and we can re-open scheduling.

Appreciate you being flexible — I’d still like to keep the SOW draft and the two-pager (if you can send) for procurement review later.

Best,
Aditi Shah
Head of Product Operations, HelixCare
aditi.shah@helixcare.com

Sean / Karthik —

Saw Aditi’s reply this morning. Quick internal notes so we’re aligned: 

- Move HelixCare to the "waitlist / nurtured" cadence in the CRM and set a 90-day touch reminder.
- Send the SOW draft and the one-pager to procurement contact once Sean posts them (they asked to hold scheduling, not to stop engagement).
- Offer a 30-min "office hours" slot in mid-September for any technical follow-ups; this is lower friction than a full demo and keeps the relationship warm.

I’ll update the Opportunity stage to "Paused - deprioritized" and add the sprint-priority note. If we see green flags earlier (roadmap shifts back), we’ll re-open scheduling.

Marissa

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixcare.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <michael.turner@helixcare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixCare demo hold — priority realignment and calendar pause

Hi Aditi — thanks for the update and for being transparent. Totally understand the need to reallocate sprint capacity — this is pretty common. Two small asks while we park the demo: 

1) If you’re comfortable, can you share the procurement contact (or cc them) so we can send the SOW draft and the short compliance checklist now? That way procurement can review on their timeline without requiring product cycles.

2) Would you like us to add HelixCare to a quarterly "pilot re-evaluation" batch (we do a short outreach with product/infra leads) and tentatively ping you in early October? If so, we’ll set the CRM reminder and drop a 20-min calendar placeholder with an explicit note that it’s tentative.

If neither works, no problem — we’ll keep this parked and follow up in ~90 days. I attached the SOW draft and a short one-pager per Aditi’s ask.

Thanks again — enjoy the vendor visits.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, HelixCare-one-pager.pdf
